name: Nginx - Error Logs
description: The Nginx - Error Logs Analysis Dashboard provides a high-level view of log level breakdowns,  comparisons, and trends. The panels also show the geographic locations of clients and clients with critical messages, new connections and outliers, client requests, request trends, and request outliers.
title: Nginx - Error Logs

queries.queryString:
deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} webengine.cluster.name={{webengine.cluster.name}} webengine.node.name={{webengine.node.name}} sumo.datasource=nginx
| json auto maxdepth 1 nodrop
| if (isEmpty(log), _raw, log) as nginx_log_message
| parse regex field=nginx_log_message "\s\[(?<Log_Level>\S+)\]\s\d+#\d+:\s(?:\*\d+\s|)(?<Message>[A-Za-z][^,]+)(?:,|$)"
| parse regex field=nginx_log_message "client:\s+(?<Client_Ip>[^,]*),\s+server:\s+(?<Server>[^,$]*)(?:,\s+request:\s+\"(?<Method>[^ ]+)\s+(?<URL>[^ ]+)\s+HTTP\/[\d\.]+\",\s+host:\s+\"(?<Host>[^\"]+)\")?"
| where !isEmpty(server)
| count by server
| sort by _count
| limit 5
